name: @local/dsh-design-studio
description: DSH agent bundle: natural-language graphic design with four production lines - VectorCraft (.vcraft), DesignCraft (.designcraft), PhotoCraft (.pcraft), and an HTML/CSS canvas rendered by headless Chromium. EffectCraft is used as a virtual studio for 3D stills: its 3D surface offers only six primitives and no texture/normal/bump/displacement channel, so real shape and material must enter through a model file (layer.newModel) - either a client model or a mesh generated by scripts/proc-mesh.py. The user is the only authority: every explicit requirement is locked verbatim in brief-lock.md and proved at delivery. Style is never chosen from a built-in catalogue - it is researched on the spot by searching the whole open web with phrases built from the user's own words, studied image by image (7 fields), and compressed into a traceable style DNA the user approves before any canvas opens. The rendered image decides, never a CLI receipt: inspect crops instead of full 4K images, prefer a script to the eye for anything checkable, and keep intermediate documents short. Motifs come first from 3D, not from a vector pen: model the shape (procedural mesh, primitive assembly or a client model), flatten the light, render it transparent, then keep the bitmap or imageTrace it into editable paths - and when downloaded free assets look cheap or off-style, build a 3D scene instead of settling.
